issue_acceptance_criteria.264:
- [ ] Add a global Executive / Operations toggle as a user presentation preference, independent of account role and Light / Dark / System theme.
- [ ] Executive mode uses a conventional restrained business dashboard: mission outcomes, needs-attention decisions/blockers, authoritative progress, responsible team, budget/spend assurance and result/PR links. Hide the spatial office, raw IDs, routine event noise and deep configuration by default.
- [ ] Never hide critical failed checks/reviewer rejection, stalled or stale state, exhausted authority, quarantine, pending required decisions or unknown cost/data merely to simplify the screen.
- [ ] Provide drilldown/open-in-Operations preserving the exact authorized mission/task/run/artifact context; toggle changes must not discard a draft or execute an action.
- [ ] Reuse the same domain state, scoped data and existing controls. No second control plane, duplicated approval model or elevated permissions.
- [ ] Persist mode preference and retain the complete Operations workflow; label unavailable aggregates rather than fabricate executive metrics.
- [ ] Verify equivalent authorized outcomes and critical alerts across both modes, themes, roles, reconnect, historical evidence, keyboard and mobile layouts.
issue_acceptance_criteria.263:
- [ ] Add a global Light / Dark / System preference, defaulting to System when unset, persisting the user's preference and avoiding a wrong-theme flash at first paint.
- [ ] Introduce semantic theme tokens and reconcile existing layered CSS overrides across the five workspaces, connection screens, forms, dialogs, result/evidence panels, code/diffs and native form controls.
- [ ] Meet WCAG AA text/non-text contrast and visible focus in both themes; status cannot depend on color alone.
- [ ] Retain appropriate office artwork/identity without filter-inverting screenshots, evidence or brand assets.
- [ ] Keep theme independent of Executive / Operations mode and authorization; changing either preference starts no operational action.
- [ ] Validate OS preference changes, explicit override, reload, keyboard, 390px, reduced motion and both presentation modes; update the light-only guidance from #141 only as explicitly scoped theme support.
